doubts: The page gives two sections (Graveyard Gully to Butchers Point, 3 hr return; Butchers Point to Doctors Point, 4–7 hr return); the full walk to Doctors Point is taken as the main way with DOC's '7–10 hr' and '20 km return via same track', and the Butchers Point walk as a shorter way. Return the same way is implied by the 'return' times and DOC's distance rather than stated in the text. DOC's '10 km' is not clearly tied to either way, so W2's distance is null. The stone huts (Leaky Lodge, Mary Ann's, Maltese Cross cottage) are historic mining huts, not huts to stay in, so huts is empty. Colemans Gully is assumed to be before Butchers Point since it is described in that section.
